Ranch Camp Ladies Rides

Stowe, VT · Mountain bike

Women / trans / femmeLGBTQ+No-drop

Ranch Camp Ladies Rides is a mountain bike group ride in Stowe, VT. Schedule: Roughly every other week, June–September; trailhead rotates (Cady Hill, Perry Hill, Little River, Adams Camp), from Rotating trailheads around Stowe; shop at 311 Mountain Rd. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @ranchcampvt the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ranch Camp Ladies Rides group ride

Free women's mountain bike rides led by Ranch Camp ambassadors, with LGBTQ+ riders explicitly welcome. Trailheads rotate around Stowe and occasionally Woodstock. Some rides are catered; order food by the Friday before. Sign up on Eventbrite.
